items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Tony Fougerat played trumpet. Mutt Powers played drums. Fliver Ford played banjo and I played piano. And that was the band.

ctx.x: 27. And then you went on to LSU?

Left there, after finishing there I got a job with a band in Baton Rouge playing in a restaurant. And we were playing spot jobs in Baton Rouge with Mutt Powers and Fliver Ford and Tony Fougerat. Oh yeah?
Fliver Ford. That's a great name, Fliver Ford. Yeah, Fliver Ford.

items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: I met Jeff Riddick, and... I don't know. A couple of boys.

ctx.x: I see they got the girls there.

Yeah, well, the band is in the back, you see. So, I went into something different for a while. I was, uh... Playing mostly stage work. And, uh... Well, I did that for a long time, too. I was batted on the road, and we hit, uh... One-nighters, and... Played all over the country. But this show, this was not a show here, the Hollywood Scandals. This was a band I had down here in New Orleans. I met Jeff Riddick, and... I don't know. A couple of boys. I don't know if you know them all.
I don't know. I see Jeff right there.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Tony Fougerat, Frank Tolke, and Marshall Farrell. Now, we had a very nice little band there.

ctx.x: That's the unit that left the Sanger Theater with my wife in it and the unit that I played for. You remember the boys from Baton Rouge that I told you? Fliver Ford. Mm-hmm. Tony Fougerat. Me and Mutt Powers. Mutt's dead. Tony's dead. Fliver's dead. And J.B. I don't know if he's still alive.
